message: Preregistered a from-scratch tokenizer scale study after CR-DEMO-0001 exposed unacceptable visual quality; dynamics remains blocked pending metric and visual gates.
Started the single v2 pipeline on the existing A10 from detached source commit 5ad134f; no old checkpoint is eligible for resume.
Bound the preregistered runner, action contract, structured collector, metrics and adaptive scale rule to the exact source commit before GPU execution.
Structured train and held-out level-disjoint datasets passed cardinality, no-op, action diversity, macro-persistence and tree-hash audits.
Probed exact sizes and native step allocations, then entered fresh n0.17m training as the first fixed-FLOPs arm.
At the user's direction, removed the conditional quality gate: all five scales must train before comparison. The first arm was still training and no held-out result existed.
Bound the unconditional five-scale runner and post-hoc ranking rule to a durable source commit while the unchanged first arm continued.
Fresh n0.17m completed 62,675 steps and held-out evaluation; n1.1m started immediately afterward.
Fresh n1.1m completed 9,358 allocated steps and scored 27.2563 dB held-out EMA clean PSNR; n3.7m started next.
Fresh n3.7m completed 2,938 allocated steps. Online clean PSNR reached 29.3045 dB while EMA clean PSNR was 26.2075 dB, leaving a 3.0971 dB endpoint gap.
The initial runner exited through its obsolete three-arm quality-gate branch even though the durable amended protocol required five unconditional arms. n8.6m and n16.6m were not started.

Closed CR-TOK-0002 without launching the old completion runner. The user identified unequal optimizer-step budgets as incompatible with the quality-first question and authorized CR-TOK-0003 with 20,000 updates per scale.
